paragraphs: The S-Type 2.7d uses the AJD-V6 — a 2.7-litre V6 diesel engine sourced from PSA, fitted to the X200-generation S-Type from 2004 to 2008. It was offered alongside petrol V6 and V8 options in the S-Type range, providing a more economical diesel alternative. The S-Type 2.7d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.7L V6 Diesel engine fitted to the S-Type 2.7d — X200 (2004–2008).
